items.q: Do Futures CFDs require physical delivery?
items.a: No. Futures CFDs are cash-settled: you trade on the price movements of the underlying futures contract without ever taking or making physical delivery of the asset.

A Futures CFD is a derivative that allows you to trade on the price movements of futures-based instruments without owning the underlying futures contract or asset. You can take long or short positions depending on whether you expect prices to rise or fall.

items.q: What leverage is available for Futures CFDs?
items.a: Leverage on Futures CFDs depends on the instrument, account type and jurisdiction, and reduces as position size increases. See our Dynamic Leverage schedule for the tiers that apply to each instrument.

items.q: What energy instruments can I trade?
items.a: GTCFX offers a range of energy CFDs, including WTI Crude Oil, Brent Crude Oil, and Natural Gas. These instruments allow you to take positions on energy price movements without owning the underlying commodities, with the flexibility to go long or short depending on your market view.

An energy CFD is a derivative that allows you to gain exposure to price movements in energy commodities such as crude oil and natural gas without owning the physical asset. Traders can go long when they expect prices to rise or go short when they expect prices to fall, while using leverage to manage their market exposure.

items.q: What spreads are available on energy products?
items.a: Spreads on Energy CFDs vary by instrument and market conditions. View our full spreads table for current pricing.

items.q: What leverage is available for energy trading?

items.q: What are the trading hours for energy markets?

items.q: What spreads do you offer on metals?
items.a: GTCFX offers Gold (XAUUSD) CFD spreads from 0.03 pips — equivalent to approximately 4 cents per ounce. Silver (XAGUSD) spreads are also highly competitive. Spreads are floating and reflect live market conditions. Actual spreads may widen during periods of low liquidity or high volatility.

A metal CFD is a derivative that allows you to trade on the price movements of metals such as gold, silver, platinum, and palladium without owning the underlying physical asset. You can take long or short positions depending on whether you expect prices to rise or fall, although losses are possible in either direction.

items.q: What leverage do you offer on precious metals?
items.a: GTCFX offers leverage on Precious Metal CFDs up to 1:2000 for eligible clients of GTC Global Ltd (FSC Mauritius) and GTC Global Trade Capital Co. (VFSC Vanuatu). Leverage amplifies both potential gains and potential losses — please ensure you understand the risks before trading with leverage.
